Gyarados

Water Flying

Kanto · Generation 1

Gyarados is a Water/Flying-type Atrocious Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 6.5 m tall and weighs 235 kg. It evolves from Magikarp. Its highest base stat is Attack (125), with a base stat total of 540.
